description.content: Returns a list of courses that the requesting user is permitted to view.
Updates one or more fields in a course.
Returns a list of course work that the requester is permitted to view.
Updates one or more fields of a course work.
Returns a list of student submissions.
Returns a list of students of this course.
Adds a user as a student of a course.
Returns a list of teachers of this course.
Creates a teacher of a course.
Returns the list of topics that the requester is permitted to view.

The Google Classroom API manages courses, coursework, student submissions, announcements, materials, rosters, topics, invitations, guardians, and integrations with third-party add-ons for educational workflows.
